name: 12dpl-debugger
description: Step-through debugging for 12d Model macros (12dPL) via source instrumentation and the Debug Adapter Protocol.

outDir.description: Folder the instrumented copy of the macro is written to. Compile and run the entry file from here.

stopOnEntry.description: Pause on the first line of main.

compileCommand.description: Optional compiler to run after instrumenting, e.g. "\"C:/Program Files/12d/.../cc4d.exe\" \"${file}\"" or a list [program, arg, ...]. It is started directly, without PowerShell or cmd, so it must be an .exe. ${file} is replaced with the instrumented entry file, ${outDir} with outDir.

pollIntervalMs.description: How often the adapter checks for messages from 12d.

inspectors.description: Functions that show what is inside a value with no text form, written as 12dPL signatures. The first parameter is the inspected value and each & parameter becomes a member, e.g. "Integer Get_name(Element elt, Text &name)". Other parameters can be literals: "Integer Get_attribute(Element elt, \"width\", Real &width)". Inspectors for a type replace the built-in ones for that type (Element: name, type, points, model; Model: name, items).

inspectDepth.description: How many levels of inspected members to expand (an Element's model's members are level 2).

includePaths.description: Extra folders to look in for #include "..." files, after the including file's folder and the entry file's folder (e.g. the 12d project folder).

configurationSnippets.label: 12dPL: Launch
configurationSnippets.description: Instrument a macro and wait for it to be run in 12d Model.
